translations.source: Combat arena. Drag to move. Automatic weapons target nearby enemies.
translations.translation: 战斗竞技场. 拖动移动 。 自动武器瞄准附近的敌人.

translations.source: Build it. Merge it. Survive the swarm.
translations.translation: 建 it. 合并起来。 幸存群生.

translations.source: Dash in your last movement direction. Escape a warning just before impact for a perfect dodge.
translations.translation: 朝你最后的方向飞去 在撞击前逃出警告 躲起来

translations.source: Drag to steer; Dash follows your last direction (up before your first move). Combine two modules to evolve your weapon. Watch for bonus wave events.
translations.translation: 拖曳来引导; Dash 遵循您的最后一个方向( 在您第一次移动前上) 。 结合两个模块来演化出你的武器. 注意奖金波事件.

translations.source: Drag anywhere in the arena to move
translations.translation: 在竞技场的任何地方拖动
每一次探险都会带来进步.

translations.source: The swarm is waiting. Bring something ridiculous.
translations.translation: war群等. 拿些可笑的东西来

translations.source: Survival and Arena continue until defeat or retreat. Other modes last two minutes; Boss Rush ends after three bosses.
translations.translation: 生存和竞技场持续到失败或撤退. 其他模式持续两分钟;Boss Rush结束于三个Boss.

translations.source: Keep a record of your discoveries.
Every two levels unlock another squad slot.
translations.translation: 每两层就打开另一个小队位置

translations.source: Each level earns 2 scrap and 4 credits per offline minute.
translations.translation: 每一级每离线一分钟可赚到2份废品和4份信贷。

translations.source: Rebuild a home for rescued robots.
translations.translation: 为获救的机器人重建家园.

translations.source: A gathering place for city traders.
Each level gives your squad +5% damage.
translations.translation: 每个关卡都让你的班员+5%受损.

translations.source: Build and fuse weapons from salvaged components.
translations.translation: 利用回收部件制造和引信武器。

translations.source: Same loadout. Your turn to beat this run.
translations.translation: 同样的载出。 轮到你击败这跑步。

translations.source: A rotating seeded arena. Everyone starts with the same loaner weapon and squad. Your upgrades and purchases give no advantage.
translations.translation: 一个旋转的种子竞技场。 每个人都用同样的出借武器和小队开始. 你的升级和购买没有任何优势。

translations.source: Use SQS1- followed by eight hexadecimal characters.
translations.translation: 使用 SQS1- 后有八个十六进制字符.

translations.source: Offline challenge codes, not live multiplayer. Replay any saved code, even after its day ends. Comparisons require the same game version.
translations.translation: 离线挑战代码,不是直播多人. 重放任何已保存的代码, 即使在它结束之后 。 比较需要相同的游戏版本.

translations.source: A little scrap. A lot of possibility.
translations.translation: 一点点废墟。 许多可能性。

translations.source: A cold front needs a big entrance.
Give a humble blaster a warmer heart.
translations.translation: 给一个谦卑的爆破手一个温暖的心脏。

translations.source: Cool down a scatter of scrap.
A bigger payload needs a higher perch.
translations.translation: 更大的有效载荷需要更高的载荷。

translations.source: Light can take the scenic route.
Split a beam until reality gives way.
translations.translation: 拆开一根梁直到现实让位.

translations.source: Founder’s Gold finish for BOLT, golden weapon trails and a Founder badge. Cosmetic only.
translations.translation: 创始人的黄金完成 BOLT黄金武器线索和创始人徽章 只有化妆品

translations.source: One-time purchase. No subscription. No combat or reward bonuses.
translations.translation: 一次性购买. 没有订阅。 没有战斗和奖励奖金

translations.source: Unlock this robot through gameplay to use its finish.
translations.translation: 通过游戏游戏解锁此机器人,以使用其完成.

translations.source: Aurora BOLT, Cobalt TANK and Rose PATCH finishes. Robot unlocks are earned through gameplay.
translations.translation: 奥罗拉 BOLT钴 TANK 和罗丝 PATCH 结束。 机器人解锁是通过游戏游戏获得的.

translations.source: You need more resources for this upgrade.
translations.translation: 您需要更多的资源来升级 。

translations.source: The game content could not be loaded.
Choose a valid squad or pair of different weapons.
translations.translation: 选择一个有效的小队或两支不同的武器.

translations.source: Saved progress could not be read. The original save is preserved; new progress cannot be saved.
translations.translation: 无法读取已保存的进展 。 原保存保存; 新的进展无法保存 。

translations.source: This action has not been unlocked yet.
This upgrade is already at its maximum level.
translations.translation: 这次升级已经达到最大水平.

translations.source: You are missing a weapon or component.
The purchase could not be verified or completed. Please try again.
translations.translation: 无法核实或完成购买。 请再试一次

translations.source: Defeat the marked elite squad before time runs out: +60 scrap.
translations.translation: 在时间耗尽前击败有标志的精英分队:+60报废.

translations.source: Dodge the falling scrap and survive the countdown: +40 scrap.
translations.translation: 躲过倒地的废墟并活过倒地倒计时:+40废墟.

translations.source: Destroy the fleeing gold carrier before it escapes: +40 scrap.
translations.translation: 在出逃前将出逃的"黄金"载体摧毁:+40报废.

translations.source: Fire Core + Overclock Module: three orbiting fireballs burn nearby enemies.
translations.translation: Fire Core + Overhour Module: 三道绕行的火球会燃烧附近的敌人.

translations.source: Explosive Payload + Critical Processor: marked artillery strikes land after a short delay.
translations.translation: 爆炸性有效载荷+临界处理器:在短暂延迟后有标记的火炮会击中陆地.

translations.source: Tesla Coil + a splitting module: an electric ring damages and slows enemies.
translations.translation: Tesla Coil + 一个分拆模块:一个电环会破坏并减缓敌人.

translations.source: Your best runs, earned medals and wildest inventions. Progress is saved on this device. Keep playing at your own pace.
translations.translation: 你最好的跑步,赚得的奖牌和最疯狂的发明。 此设备已保存进度 。 继续按自己的速度演奏

translations.source: Your first run starts the story. Finish a battle to save its highlights here.
translations.translation: 你第一次跑步开始故事 完成一场战斗来拯救它的亮点

translations.source: Two different weapons + one Mystery Core. Each listed result has an equal chance. No purchase required.
translations.translation: 两个不同的武器+一个神秘核心. 每个列出的结果都有平等机会。 无需购买。

translations.source: Every great idea starts with two questionable parts.
translations.translation: 每个伟大的想法都从两个可疑的部分开始.
发明一些令人发指的东西
猎人老大 打败三个老大
combo 艺人 \ 达到 16- kill 链
实地测试 完成3次运行

translations.source: New tasks arrive without streak penalties.
translations.translation: 新任务到来时没有累赘惩罚

translations.source: Your expedition brought back real salvage. Rewards accumulate for up to eight hours.
translations.translation: 你的远征带回了真正的拯救。 奖励累积最长达8小时.

translations.source: A heavy-armour TANK design with a tower shield, reinforced shoulders, animated stride and victory salute. Unlock TANK through gameplay.
translations.translation: 重装甲 TANK 设计时有塔盾,加固后肩,动画出步和胜利致敬. 解锁 TANK 通过游戏游戏。

translations.source: You already own part of this collection. Buy only your missing products below; the bundle is unavailable to avoid duplicate purchases.
translations.translation: 你已经拥有这个收藏的一部分。 下面只购买您缺失的产品; 捆绑没有可用以避免重复购买 。

translations.source: Solar Ronin BOLT, Iron Bastion TANK, Star Medic PATCH and Prism Arsenal. Four permanent cosmetic products; no robot unlocks or combat bonuses.
translations.translation: 太阳罗宁 BOLT铁铸造 TANK,星际医学家 PATCH 和棱镜阿森纳。 4种永久化妆品;没有机器人解锁或战斗奖金.

translations.source: A winged PATCH design with a luminous halo, medical insignia, animated stride and victory salute. Unlock PATCH through gameplay.
translations.translation: 一个翅膀 PATCH 设计有发光光光环,医疗徽章,动画出行步和胜利致敬. 解锁 PATCH 通过游戏游戏。

translations.source: Drag to steer the preview squad. Try Dash to see the skin in motion.
translations.translation: 拖曳以引导预览组 。 试试Dash看皮肤在运动

translations.source: Preview only. No purchases, ownership changes, rewards or progress are saved.
translations.translation: 仅预览. 采购、所有权变更、奖励或进展均无所节省。

translations.source: Mint and violet weapon trails, diamond impact sparks and prism projectile colours. Cosmetic only; attack damage and enemy warnings stay the same.
translations.translation: 薄荷和紫外线武器痕迹 钻石撞击火花和棱镜射出颜色 只有化妆品;攻击破坏和敌人警告保持不变.

translations.source: A sun-forged BOLT design with a crested helmet, energy blade, animated stride and victory salute. Cosmetic only; BOLT is earned through gameplay.
translations.translation: 被阳光照射过 BOLT 设计时会佩戴有被封住的头盔,有能量的刀片,有动画快活和胜利致敬. 仅化妆; BOLT 通过游戏游戏获得。
脉冲破裂:损害附近的敌人.
有效载荷专家:增加喷洒损害。
第三安全处. 友谊第一。

translations.source: Scramble: damages and slows nearby enemies.
translations.translation: S:损害和减缓附近的敌人.

translations.source: Salvage pulse: area damage and a small repair.
translations.translation: 救援脉冲:地区损伤和小修.

translations.source: One robot’s trash is their treasure.
translations.translation: 一个机器人的垃圾就是他们的宝藏。
太阳脉冲:损害附近的敌人.

translations.source: Quiet until the lights go out.

translations.translation: 修补脉搏:恢复35%的班级健康.

translations.source: Repair field: regenerate 0.6 health per second.
translations.translation: 维修场:每秒0.6次再生健康.
一切应该有第二次机会。

translations.source: Fortify: immune to damage for 5 seconds.
Heavy chassis: a larger health pool.
translations.translation: 重底盘:规模较大的健康池.

translations.source: Flash burst: pulse damage and an immediate next shot.
translations.translation: 闪光爆破:脉冲损伤和立即下一轮.
已经到了 已经无聊了

translations.source: Resets zone, city buildings, robot levels, credits and scrap. Keeps robots, squad capacity, squad, weapons, weapon levels, components, cores, blueprints, achievements and preferences. Each reboot permanently adds 10% damage. Unlock at zone 6.
translations.translation: 恢复区域,城市建筑,机器人水平,信用和废品。 保留机器人,小队能力,小队,武器,武器级别,组件,核心,蓝图,成就和喜好. 每次重启都会增加10%的损伤. 解锁在6区。

translations.source: Your progress could not be saved. Check device storage and retry before closing the app.
translations.translation: 您的进步无法保存 。 在关闭应用程序前检查设备存储和重试 。

translations.source: Purchase cancelled. You have not been charged.
translations.translation: 采购取消。 你没有被起诉。

translations.source: Cosmetics are optional. Prices come from the App Store. Restore purchases using the Apple Account that bought them. All gameplay and progression remain available without buying a pack.
translations.translation: 化妆品是可选的. 价格来自App Store. 使用购买它们的苹果账户恢复购买. 所有游戏游戏和进取都可用而不购买一包.

translations.source: No previous cosmetic purchases were found for this Apple Account.
translations.translation: 这个苹果账户没有发现之前的化妆品购买.

translations.source: This purchase was refunded or revoked. Its cosmetics are no longer available.
translations.translation: 这一购买被退还或被撤销。 其化妆品已无用.

translations.source: The core adventure is free. No mandatory ads.
translations.translation: 核心冒险是自由的. 没有强制广告。

translations.source: Purchases are currently unavailable. Please try Refresh later.
translations.translation: 目前无法购买。 请稍候再刷新
无限协同效应:+15%武器损坏

translations.source: The first robot in your squad leads its active ability.
translations.translation: 你班里的第一个机器人 领导着它的主动能力
你们这些不适应的英雄

translations.source: An optional warm coral paint finish for BOLT.
translations.translation: 可选的暖珊瑚颜料完成 BOLT。 。 。

translations.source: An optional midnight blue paint finish for NOVA.
translations.translation: 可选的午夜蓝漆完成 NOVA。 。 。

translations.source: Choose Critical Processor and Overclock Module in one run for +15% critical chance and +20% attack speed.
translations.translation: 在一次运行中选择临界处理器和超时模块,用于+15%的关键机会和+20%的攻击速度.

translations.source: Choose Tesla Coil and Drone Core or Splitter Module in one run for two extra chain targets.
translations.translation: 在一次运行中选择 Tesla Coil 和 Drone Core 或 Splitter 模块,为两个额外的链式目标.

translations.source: Choose Fire Core and Cryo Core in one run for +35% weapon damage.
translations.translation: 选择火芯和 Cryo Core 在一次运行中 +35% 武器损坏。

translations.source: Drag in battle to dodge attacks. Your squad fires automatically. Choose upgrades, bring home scrap, and combine weapons with cores in the Workshop. Build the Expedition Dock to earn salvage while away.
translations.translation: 在战斗中拖着躲避攻击 你的班自动开火 选择升级,带回家废品,并在车间中将武器与核心结合. 建造远征码头 以赚取抢救的同时离开。
让我们来构建一些东西

translations.source: Shots slow enemies for two seconds.
translations.translation: 枪声让敌人慢了两秒钟

translations.source: Add an extra projectile to each volley.
Shots burn enemies for three seconds.
Shots damage enemies near their target.
translations.translation: 枪击伤害了目标附近的敌人。

translations.source: Add two projectiles to each volley.
Hit two additional targets each volley.
Electric bolts jump between nearby machines.
translations.translation: 电栓在附近的机器之间跳动.

translations.source: Cold light fractures into a dazzling storm.
A salvaged rivet driver. Small beginnings, big intentions.
translations.translation: 一个抢救出来的司机 小的开始,大的意图。

translations.source: Frozen shells burst into a cloud of shrapnel.
translations.translation: 冰冻炮弹爆裂成碎片云.

translations.source: A branching current finds every loose screw.
translations.translation: 一条树枝流会发现每个松散的螺丝

translations.source: A tiny flying furnace follows your lead.
Hot rivets leave a persistent burn.
A cold front made from industrial coolant.
translations.translation: 用工业冷却剂制造的冷锋

translations.source: A cutting tool with a new job.
translations.translation: 一个有新工作的剪切工具.

translations.source: Rebuilt satellites rain down precision fire.
translations.translation: 重新建造的卫星会降下精确的火力.

translations.source: An unstable electric furnace bends the air.
translations.translation: 不稳定的电炉使空气弯曲.

translations.source: Split light ricochets through the swarm.

translations.translation: 回收燃料。 无循环的热情.

translations.source: Three bolts, one very loud opinion.
translations.translation: 三个螺栓,一个非常响亮的意见。

translations.source: An impossible invention. Please stand back.
translations.translation: 一个不可能的发明。 请退后

translations.source: A flock of guided rockets with terrible manners.
translations.translation: 一群有导引力的火箭 举止恶劣
